reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: MLIPs trained on ab initio liquid data are known to better capture many-body interactions and configurational diversity than EAM potentials, making improved phase-space overlap and reduced TI mismatch highly plausible.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, with a well-defined quantitative falsification criterion (≥30% reduction in mismatch), though practical details on generating identical configurations and computing overlap metrics are slightly glossed over.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful, non-trivial proposal that directly addresses the core methodological limitation of TOR-TILD, offering a concrete path to more accurate free energies for refractory HEAs.
